com.github.mangstadt.vinnie.io

Class FoldedLineWriter

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.io.Writer
      • com.github.mangstadt.vinnie.io.FoldedLineWriter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, Flushable, Appendable, AutoCloseable

    public class FoldedLineWriter
extends Writer
    Automatically folds lines as they are written.
    Author:
    Michael Angstadt

      • FoldedLineWriter

        public FoldedLineWriter(Writer writer,
                        int lineLength,
                        String indent)
        Creates a folded line writer.
        Parameters:
        writer - the writer object to wrap
        lineLength - the maximum length a line can be before it is folded (excluding the newline)
        indent - the string that is prepended onto each folded line. Must have a length of at least one and must consist only of tabs and spaces
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if line length or indent are invalid

    • Method Detail

      • writeQuotedPrintable

        public void writeQuotedPrintable(String encoded)
                          throws IOException

        Writes a string that's been encoded in quoted-printable encoding.

        The folded line writer must know that a quoted-printable string is being written because an equals character must be appended onto each folded line, and the next line must receive no indentation whitespace.

        Parameters:
        encoded - the quoted-printable string
        Throws:
        IOException - if there's a problem writing to the output stream
